subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible Gateway requests tolerate or ignore a generic body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The mechanical code path is narrow, but the choice changes public API semantics for model selection and may need parity across Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

options.title: Adopt header precedence consistently
options.body: Accept generic body models as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and add docs/tests for the endpoint set maintainers choose to cover.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Keep requiring body `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>`, and document SDK clients to send that value with optional `x-openclaw-model`.

options.title: Hold for broader Gateway API review
options.body: Leave this open until maintainers decide one shared OpenAI-compatible precedence rule across Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

recommendation.title: Adopt header precedence consistently
recommendation.body: Accept generic body models as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and add docs/tests for the endpoint set maintainers choose to cover.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible contract and broader endpoint behavior this decision would change.
